title: Application to Market a New or Abbreviated New Drug or Biologic for Human Use
provenance: Official FDA secured PDF provided by the product owner (upload); canonical source: fda.gov forms catalog. Decrypted at onboarding with pikepdf — the committed asset is the decrypted form, and sha256 above is of those bytes. sha256EncryptedOriginal is the as-supplied encrypted file.
note: Official FDA blank form, decrypted at onboarding via scripts/ind-forms/onboard-fda-form.ts (pikepdf) because pdf-lib cannot decrypt AES. Measured on the DECRYPTED asset: a pure AcroForm with 1348 terminal fields and no /XFA entry at all. Official filling is supported and this manifest is promoted by readTemplate. The original is AES-256 (V5/R6); its permission bits /P -1036 allow form filling (bit 9) and deny content modification (bit 4). An earlier revision of this manifest recorded "xfaDynamic: true" and "0 AcroForm fields are exposed" — both false, for the same reason as FDA_1572: the count was taken through pdf-lib with ignoreEncryption, which does not decrypt.
